gztell.reason: gztell returns an integer offset value (z_off_t), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it merely queries the current position of an existing gzFile handle.

gzprintf.reason: gzprintf is variadic (accepts '...'), which makes it unsafe to expose directly in an automatic binding generator.

adler32_combine.reason: Returns a plain integer value (uLong), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply.

gzeof.reason: gzeof returns an int (not a pointer), so ownership does not apply; it merely queries the EOF state of an existing gzFile handle.

inflateInit_.reason: inflateInit_ initialises the z_stream state in caller-supplied memory and returns an int status code, not a pointer, so ownership of a returned pointer is not applicable.

crc32_combine_gen.reason: The function returns a plain integer value (uLong), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply.

adler32_z.reason: The function returns a uLong checksum value, not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle concepts do not apply; it is safe to expose as a pure computation.

get_crc_table.reason: Returns a pointer to a static internal table (crc_table) owned by the library; the caller must not free it.

adler32.reason: adler32 returns a uLong checksum value (not a pointer), so ownership does not apply; it simply computes and returns an integer.

deflate.reason: deflate returns an int status code, not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it operates on a caller-supplied z_streamp handle managed by deflateInit/deflateEnd.
